source_metadata.fetch_mode: Pinned recursive tree plus candidate raw Java only; no textures/models downloaded

mechanism: Ordinary server CAD cast resolves registered CircleSpellBullet and acceptor; validates real program/CAD, calculates circle15 modifier cost and debits player/CAD/overflow path, then instantiates world circle with copied authored spell bullet and caster UUID. Disk pair persists bullet/colorizer, caster, elapsed age, discrete casts used and lifetime/direction. Server pulse every5tick after5 rebuilds context from restored program, increments count before execution; bound20 plus elapsed lifetime limit reuse across reload without a second CAD charge. Actual safeExecute advances cloned program action stack, source registration/factory/getters traced.

semantic_comparators.input: legacy time/battery/vector keys, CapabilityData Time/Battery/Memory plus componentN/bulletN/selectedSlot payload
semantic_comparators.output: available CAD/socket capability populated; migrated keys removed from copyTag; remaining compound written back to CUSTOM_DATA
semantic_comparators.preservation: null capability skips its removal block; memory vectors require Double list with size>=3; nested CapabilityData values can override earlier flat old fields; LegacyItemStacks explicitly restores numeric Count and tag as CUSTOM_DATA after item parse
semantic_comparators.application_limit: parseOptional empty stack remains empty; therefore missing item registry can still lose content. Old key parse errors or rejected slot setters not transactionally rolled back. Whole CAD chain including parser counted once here

semantic_comparators.trigger: TilePotionBeacon.loadAdditional followed by TileBlockEntityCyclic base timer reader
semantic_comparators.input: Effects typed compound list, inherited timer, energy, inventory/filter, radius/entityFilter
semantic_comparators.output: reconstructs nonnull effects, restores inherited remaining time and paid energy/inventory
semantic_comparators.preservation: Full writer/base timer read and write/pullFromItem/tick/affectEntities reviewed. Pull consumes one potion into copied effect list and timer budget; restored effects are actually applied while timer remains, so this is paid resource state, not generic inventory wrapper. Same owner counted once.
semantic_comparators.application_limit: Effects absent retains previous list; unbounded entityFilter ordinal can throw before base timer restored; missing radius becomes0. Newer NeoForge component API is research only; timed effects must not enter Dynasty permanent whitelist.

semantic_comparators.trigger: RitualBrazierTile.loadAdditional reconstructs ritual by saved ritualID
semantic_comparators.input: ritualID, context progress/complete/started/needsMana plus consumed item stacks
semantic_comparators.output: new registry ritual attached to current tile; context reinstated without onStart or consuming input again; blank ritualID clears ritual
semantic_comparators.preservation: Read full tile, AbstractRitual, RitualContext, factory and NBT item helper. tick respects done/started/paid-source flags and calls onEnd then clears; consumedItems are stack.split(1) records, not an item-name table. Entire context/factory chain one credit.
semantic_comparators.application_limit: Unknown ritual ID results null; playerUUID set onStart is absent base writer, cannot assert actor preserved. Item helper catches exception and may return partial list; relayPos absent on reused tile may stay stale. Modern NeoForge APIs research only.

semantic_comparators.input: legacy CUSTOM_DATA.spell complete spell with validity/name/UUID/grid
semantic_comparators.output: decode legacy spell to registered component then remove old spell key on copied custom data; unrelated custom data retained
semantic_comparators.preservation: Read both full identical migration methods (one family), Spell full root pair and item get/cast/clear consumers. Full grid/piece parser pair additionally reviewed as support. Existing arbitrary CUSTOM_DATA not replaced wholesale with selected spell.
semantic_comparators.application_limit: No current-component presence guard: old spell can overwrite newer component. Invalid valid flag gives null, yet legacy key still removed; missing legacy spell changes rarity COMMON even if newer component exists. Spell grid skips unsupported pieces; no backup of unknown syntax. This is a negative recovery boundary, not guaranteed lossless fallback.

semantic_comparators.trigger: Whole SpellEmitter + SpellEmitterData disk pair/get/loadEmitters/update/add and SpellModifiers pair
semantic_comparators.input: actual authored spell metadata, coordinates/direction, full duration, castingTick and modifier map
semantic_comparators.output: defer NBT decoding until owning world available, clear old live list then instantiate saved emitter; resume server castingTick, remove on failed/cancelled/finished spell
semantic_comparators.preservation: Actual continuous world spell state, distinct previous glyph puzzle owner. Network intentionally sends remaining duration and resets client castingTick for sounds, disk retains actual elapsed progress; not counted as two persistence implementations.
semantic_comparators.application_limit: No explicit clamp of castingTick/duration or registry metadata validation. Underlying individual spell cast semantics not all traced, does not imply no repeat side effects after crash. Command-created emitter has no paid mana receipt. Modifier sync flags intentionally discarded. Historical1.12 source not API transplant.

semantic_comparators.trigger: Whole catalyst/spreader plus full SculkBlock actual growth-charge consumer
semantic_comparators.input: consumed mob XP converted to cursors of position/charge/decay-delay/update-delay/optional faces
semantic_comparators.output: codec defaults charge0 decay1 update0; restore at most32 cursors; server tick resumes world growth and charge depletion, merge preserves sum under1000
semantic_comparators.preservation: Actual earned resource removed from mob XP drop then owned by catalyst cursor queue. Same cursor/codec/list methods are supporting chain0; worldgen configuration not separate owner credit.
semantic_comparators.application_limit: Reader only clears if cursors list present, missing on reused object retains old. Codec partial parse may drop bad entries, >32 truncated; addCursors silently refuses excess capacity after mob XP suppressed. SculkBlock growth debit happens even if placement fails, no world atomicity claim. Other SculkBehaviour subclasses not full traced.

limits: Only13 explicit bounded source ranges read; generic spell compiler/cache/all individual actions, native item codec, platform service implementation and full PlayerData not audited. Local pinned source only; no upstream code execution or API compatibility claim.

ItemCAD cast gate requires availablePsi>0, not full cost. getRealCost ordinarily multiplies by circle15 but efficiency0 returns base cost, -1 returns -1; event can replace cost/context or cancel. deductPsi may use CAD reservoir or hurt overflow and infinite CAD returns. Thus ordinary original paid creation path, not proof every legal circle prepaid exactly20 full casts. Server code debits before addFreshEntity; spawning return ignored, no refund/transaction.

The copied bullet is a spell-program snapshot, not removed original ammunition. Current component spell parser already credited36c; no extra perstack/reader/UUID credit. colorizer kept reference, bullet.copy. Root old bullet parser handles legacy nested spell elsewhere; no new alias migration here.

timesCast increments before getSpell nonnull and safeExecute. Failure, null spell or unavailable executor may spend count with no effect. Not acknowledgment of successful world impact. safeExecute can delay a context into runtime handler, but delayed actions not in circle NBT; no all in-flight execution continuity claim.

Same-world getPlayerByUUID caster lookup. If offline/other dimension, timeAlive still rises and no cast count increments; finite life can expire and remaining entitlement is lost. No pause or deferred retry lifetime. Valid UUID missing on reused object does not clear old caster; malformed UUID parse throws.

No clamp of age, casts, vectors, scale or lifetime. Missing lifetime becomes0 not constructor110; huge/negative counts can alter repetitions. tick calls remove when age>lifetime but does not return, so same tick may still execute eligible cast. Client also increments time/casts; safeExecute exits client, so local counters not server receipt.

BreakLoop uses timesCast20 and timesAlive100, but actual persisted age key is timeAlive. It calls full entity.load with only custom save fragment. This does stop future repetitions by cast limit in valid normal path but does not prove immediate expiry or safe base position restoration. No native Entity.load run or standard data hooks claimed.

World-owned finite cast lease is transient and must not enter Dynasty permanent player Clone whitelist. No general copiedroot, no new penalty, no mutation of original saves/production. Whole finite programmed burst owner at most1, not each20 cast/field/resource/platform.

The closest existing6b19 world continuous spell emitter already restores spell/program/time but is command-created without paid mana receipt. Need independent judgment whether physical copied-bullet entitlement plus upfront cost and consumed discrete repeat quota distinguishes this owner sufficiently; scalar iteration alone cannot justify another credit. Existing Ars ritual/sculk/effectbeacon paid budgets remain possible dedup comparators.
